description_en: Deletes a scaling configuration of the Elastic Container Instance type. If the scaling configuration of a scaling group is in the Inactive state and the scaling group contains no elastic container instances created from the scaling configuration, you can call the DeleteEciScalingConfiguration operation to delete the scaling configuration to free up the scaling configuration quota
description_zh: 当前伸缩配置处于未生效状态，且伸缩组中不存在使用该伸缩配置自动创建的ECI实例，您可以调用API DeleteEciScalingConfiguration删除不再需要的一个ECI类型的伸缩配置，可以有效避免占用伸缩配置的配额
kebab_example: aliyun ess delete-eci-scaling-configuration --scaling-configuration-id asc-bp1bx8mzur534edp0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2022-02-22 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteEciScalingConfiguration

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scaling configuration that you want to delete
parameters.name: scaling_configuration_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: region_id
